info.title: API.SH: Realtor
info.description: The Realtor API from API.SH: public Realtor data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Location suggestions as Realtor.com's search box gives them: cities, ZIP codes, neighborhoods, counties, streets, addresses (with property id), schools and parks, with coordinates and slugs to use as location.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realtor-autocomplete

parameters.description: Comma-separated types (city, postal_code, address, neighborhood, county, street, school, school_district, university, park).

get.description:
One property on Realtor.com: status, list price, beds, baths, square feet, lot, year built, type, description, all photos, price and sale history, tax history, nearby schools with ratings, value estimates, features, HOA fee, flood factor, open houses, MLS source and the listing agent and office. Give the `property_id` or a property `url`, or `q` (a city, ZIP code or address) to open the first current listing there; add `status` to open the first for-rent, sold or pending one instead.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realtor-property

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Realtor.com property link instead of `property_id`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: City, ZIP code, neighborhood or address; the first current listing there is returned.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Realtor.com home search (for sale, for rent, sold)
get.description:
Homes for sale, for rent, pending or recently sold on Realtor.com in a city, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or address: list price, sold price and date, last sale, beds, baths, square feet, lot, year built, type, description, flags (new listing, price reduced, foreclosure, new construction, pending, contingent), open houses, coordinates, county, MLS, listing agents and brokers, estimate, HOA fee, pet policy and photos. Rentals can be limited to those allowing cats or dogs. `total` is the number of matches; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page; up to 50 pages of `limit`). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realtor-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or address.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price (list price, rent, or sold price with status=sold).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma list: single_family, condos, townhomes, multi_family, mobile, land, farm, duplex_triplex, condo_townhome, condo_townhome_rowhome_coop, apartment, coop.

parameters.name: sold_within_days
parameters.description: With status=sold: sold in the last N days.

parameters.name: listed_within_days
parameters.description: Listed in the last N days.

parameters.name: price_reduced_within_days
parameters.description: Price reduced in the last N days.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Widen the search area by N miles.

parameters.name: open_house
parameters.description: true: homes with an open house.

parameters.name: pets
parameters.description: Rentals that allow these pets: cats, dogs or cats,dogs (use with status=for_rent).

parameters.name: photos
parameters.description: true: include every photo URL (default: the main photo only).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realtor-similar

parameters.name: property_id
parameters.description: Property id or realtor.com property link.

get.description:
Recently sold homes in a city, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or address: sold price and date, list price, last sale, beds, baths, square feet, lot, year built, type, description, address, coordinates, county, MLS, listing agents and brokers and photos, newest sale first by default. Takes the same filters as the home search. `total` is the number of matches; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page; up to 50 pages of `limit`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/realtor-sold

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or address.

parameters.name: sold_within_days
parameters.description: Only homes sold in the last N days.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated property types (single_family, condos, townhomes, multi_family, mobile, land, farm, duplex_triplex, apartment, coop).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the location.

parameters.name: photos
parameters.description: Include every photo of each home.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
